items.actClause:
AN ACT directing the New York state energy research and development authority
to establish a ride clean rebate program
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S314

SPONSOR: SALAZAR
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act directing the New York state energy research and development
authority to establish a ride clean rebate program

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

An act to direct NYSERDA to establish a Ride Clean Rebate Program in
parallel with the Drive Clean Rebate Program. In line with the legaliza-
tion of class one, class two, and class three bicycles with electric
assist passed in the Governor's 2020 Budget (see: Vehicle & Traffic Law
Section 102-c) this bill will encourage the expansion of electric bikes
across New York State. Using the same funding, the Ride Clean Rebate
Program would expand carbon-free mobility across New York State.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 directs the New York State Research and Development Authority
(NYSERDA) to create a Ride Clean Rebate Program to allow class one,
class two, and class three bicycles with electric assists and electric
scooters to be eligible for a 50% rebate-2- up to $1,100 USD in a Ride
Clean Rebate.

Section 2 sets the effective date as immediate upon enactment.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Whereas e-bikes became legal in past years and are seen in tandem with
electric vehicles as part of the low carbon mobility future, and 75
percent of auto trips and 55 percent of transit trips in NYC are under
five miles, this rebate would encourage more New Yorkers to purchase and
utilize e-bikes for trips under five-miles removing congestion, traffic,
and harmful emissions from our roads and air.

By establishing a Ride Clean Rebate Program in parallel with the Drive
Clean Rebate Program that launched in 2017, New York State would diver-
sify its clean transportation strategy to further build a clean, resil-
ient, and affordable energy system.

Additionally, funding for the Drive Clean Rebate Program was allocated
in the State Budget and has not been fully paid out. This would also be
a stimulus to new entrepreneurship as electric bicycles are an emerging
industry in New York State in the period since legalization of the tech-
nology.

 
ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE IMPACT:

This legislation would help to mitigate the impacts of climate change by
reducing carbon emissions, overall traffic and congestion, and encourag-
ing a shift to renewable modes of transportation.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

SENATE:

2020: S9019 (Salazar)- Referred to rules
2021: S3080A (Salazar)- Referred to Energy and Telecommunications,
Amend, Recommit to Energy and Telecommunications, Committed to Rules,
Passed Senate.

2022: Referred to Energy and Telecommunications, Committed to Rules,
Passed Senate

ASSEMBLY:

2020: A10974 (Carroll)- Referred to Energy

2021: A516A (Caroll)- Referred to Energy, Amend, recommit to Energy,
referred to Ways and Means

2022: Referred to Ways and Means

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

Minimal

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately

A.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to directing the New
York state energy research and development authority to establish a ride clean
rebate program
A.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S314A

SPONSOR: SALAZAR
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the public authorities law, in relation to directing the
New York state energy research and development authority to establish a
ride clean rebate program

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

An act to direct NYSERDA to establish a Ride Clean Rebate Program. In
line with the legalization of class one, class two, and class three
bicycles with electric assist passed in the Governor's 2020 Budget (see:
Vehicle & Traffic Law Section 102-c), this bill will encourage the
expansion of electric bikes across New York State, thereby expanding
carbon-free mobility across New York State.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 amends the public authorities law by adding a new section 1885
establishing a "ride clean program" to allow purchasers of bicycles with
electric assists and electric scooters to be eligible for a 50% (up to
$1,100) rebate, providing the battery on the bike or scooter has been
certified by an accredited testing laboratory for compliance with a safe
battery standard. NYSERDA is directed to establish and implement this
program and to issue annual reports detailing the status of the program.

Section 2 sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

E-bikes and electric cars are part of the low carbon mobility future.
Given that seventy-five percent of auto trips and fifty-five percent of
transit trips in NYC are under five miles, this rebate would encourage
more New Yorkers to purchase and utilize e-bikes for trips under five-
miles removing congestion, traffic, and harmful emissions from our roads
and air. This would also be a stimulus to new entrepreneurship as elec-
tric bicycles are an emerging industry in New York State.

 
ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE IMPACT:

This legislation would help to mitigate the impacts of climate change by
reducing carbon emissions, overall traffic and congestion, and encourag-
ing a shift to renewable modes of transportation.

 
AMENDED BILL

The "A" print of the bill makes technical changes and also explicitly
requires that batteries in e-bike or electric scooters eligible for the
rebate be certified by an accredited testing laboratory for compliance
with a safe battery standard.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2021: S3080A - Referred to Energy and Telecommunications, Referred to
Energy and Telecommunications, discharged to Rules, passed Senate, 60 -
3.

2021: A516A (Caroll)- Referred to Energy, Amend, recommit to Energy,

2022: Referred to Ways and Means

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

Minimal

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately

summary: Directs the New York state energy and development authority to establish a ride clean rebate program for electric assist bicycles and electric scooters; defines terms; provides a fifty percent rebate for eligible purchases.
title: Establishes a ride clean rebate program for bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters
